sources.snippet: Relevant source files Purpose and Scope This page documents the LLM-based ASR models in the omnilingual-asr system, which belong to the wav2vec2_llama model family. These models combine wav2vec2 audio encoders with language model decoders to enable language-conditioned transcription and zero-shot learning capabilities.
